title: A phase-field neural solver for moving contact line problems with dynamic boundary conditions
summary: Phase-field models based on the Cahn--Hilliard equation coupled with dynamic boundary conditions provide a thermodynamically consistent framework for moving contact line (MCL) problems. Although physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer a mesh-free approach for solving partial differential equations, their direct application to MCL problems remains challenging due to long-time error accumulation, sharp interfacial profiles, localized contact line dynamics, and complex contact angle evolution.
